intro: Written for a death scene in Sam Peckinpah's western Pat Garrett and Billy the Kid, in which Dylan also acted. Two short verses that turned into one of his most recorded songs.

lives.title: For the film
lives.note: Recorded for the soundtrack to play under the death of a sheriff. Released on Pat Garrett & Billy the Kid in July 1973; the single reached number 12 in the US.

lives.title: On tour with the Band
lives.note: Added to the 1974 shows. The 1974 shows are not in this site's concert data yet.

lives.title: Rolling Thunder
lives.note: Part of the 1975 Rolling Thunder shows, sung with the whole troupe behind him.

lives.title: Reggae
lives.note: Recast with a reggae lilt by the 1978 band. On Bob Dylan at Budokan.

others.note: On Use Your Illusion II; a number two single in the UK.
